# Opening without Jo

Rafi opened the workshop using the draft instructions. He found the right breaker but couldn't tell whether the water stain was new. Add a photograph of the ordinary state, with a date, beside the checklist. Compliance training hadn't covered how to ask whether something is unusual. [[Volunteer handbook]] can make uncertainty easier to report without promising that a checklist contains every possible incident.
